item.title: DolphiniOS v5.0.0
item.description:
DolphiniOS 5.0.0 | Non-Jailbroken
* Fixed JIT support on A13/A14/M1 devices running iOS 27 beta. (@CelloSerenity) * Fixed wrong app version number introduced in 5.0.0b5. (@CelloSerenity)
The next update will be sometime after the next official Dolphin release. It will include a core update.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OatmealDome/dolphin-ios/compare/v5.0.0b5...v5.0.0b6
